verdict.rationale: Ollama documents an `ollama launch` command that sets up and runs third-party coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex) against local or cloud models with no environment variables or config files. The homepage repeats the one-command launch claim, and the GitHub README lists Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and Copilot as agents it connects to. missing for 10: in-depth reference docs for `ollama launch` (supported agent list, flags, model selection), independent or hands-on corroboration that the one-command setup works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command

citations.quote: ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models. No environment variables or config files needed.
Launch Claude Code, Codex, and more with one command.
connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as `Claude Code`, `OpenClaw`, `OpenCode` , `Codex`, `Copilot`,  and more.
